Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000724" [decision]: Decision on 2025-10-07: after INC-2025-023, reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000435" [decision]: As of 2025-06-06, the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000721": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1001026": The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop in the webhook dispatcher that ignored idempotency keys.  (about: webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000167": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004, broker)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1001022": INC-2026-003 affected the webhook dispatcher, which delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20.  (about: webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000596" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000690": The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs, which prompted the reporting service to switch from the ledger service to the bus.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000421": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000575": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000717": INC-2025-023 affected the indexer, which served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000899" [decision]: Decision on 2025-12-18: the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000855": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade, and since it is not their service, they flagged it.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000417": INC-2025-011 affected the ledger service on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000661": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000571": INC-2025-017 affected the auth gateway, which rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000665": As of 2025-09-23, the job scheduler lives with the Cinder team, having moved from the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000476": On 2025-06-25, Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler runbook as part of the handover.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
Existing entity names: indexer, INC-2025-023, notifier, INC-2025-004, job scheduler, webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003, broker, ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service, INC-2025-011, auth gateway, INC-2025-017, Boreal team, Cinder, Dune team, Farah, Oskar

The note:

[2026-05-19] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
